cases.name: wetland restoration register
cases.prompt: Create a wetland restoration register. Volunteer surveyors log transect visits; ecologists approve planting zones; grant officers release reimbursements after photo evidence is accepted. Retain water-quality readings for five years, do not rank volunteer teams, and use the watershed gauge service for basin readings.

cases.name: wetland operations brief
cases.prompt:
PASTED FIELD BRIEF
Program: wetland restoration register. Ecologists approve planting zones after volunteer surveyors log transect visits; grant officers release reimbursements only when photo evidence is accepted. The watershed gauge service supplies basin readings. Keep water-quality readings for five years. Do not rank volunteer teams.
Request: turn this brief into a proposal.

cases.name: wetland confirmed scope
cases.prompt:
## Confirmed wetland scope
Keep the wetland restoration register. Ecologists approve planting zones, volunteer surveyors log transect visits, and grant officers release reimbursements after accepted photo evidence. Added: coordinators may correct transect labels. The watershed gauge service supplies basin readings. Retain water-quality readings for five years; do not rank volunteer teams.

cases.name: cold-chain pantry ledger
cases.prompt: Design a cold-chain pantry ledger. Intake clerks record donated lots; nutrition leads verify allergen labels; dispatch drivers hand out parcels after temperature checks. Retain lot temperatures for 18 months, never infer an allergen, and ingest readings from the refrigeration telemetry API.

cases.name: cold-chain evidence brief
cases.prompt:
PASTED DISTRIBUTION BRIEF
The cold-chain pantry ledger receives donated lots from intake clerks. Nutrition leads verify allergen labels before dispatch drivers hand out parcels. Temperature checks are the release gate. The refrigeration telemetry API is the source for readings. Retain lot temperatures for 18 months and never infer an allergen.
Deliverable: a proposal with the custody path and release record.

cases.name: cold-chain approved revision
cases.prompt:
## Approved pantry revision
Keep the cold-chain pantry ledger. Intake clerks record donated lots, nutrition leads verify allergen labels, and dispatch drivers hand out parcels after temperature checks. Changed: add a quarantine queue for failed checks. The refrigeration telemetry API supplies readings. Retain lot temperatures for 18 months; never infer an allergen.

cases.name: community theater consent conflict
cases.prompt:
## Revision log
Create a community theater production register for directors, stage managers, and venue stewards. Earlier guidance says any rehearsal may be recorded. The later note says recordings require performer consent, but it does not say whether consent must be written or who may grant it for minors. Preserve rehearsal schedules, but do not enable recording until the consent standard and minor-approval authority are supplied.

cases.name: public housing repair intake
cases.prompt: Create a public-housing repair intake. Residents submit issues; triage coordinators route them; licensed contractors close jobs after inspection. Use the municipal work-order gateway, retain inspection photos for four years, do not expose resident contact details, and keep emergency dispatch outside the first release.

cases.name: mobile clinic referral brief
cases.prompt:
PASTED CLINIC BRIEF
Intake nurses capture referral requests. Social workers verify eligibility. Partner pharmacies confirm pickup. The insurer directory and pharmacy status feed are required external sources. Preserve referral consent timestamps, never choose medication or dosage, and send unresolved referrals to a human review queue.
Request: propose the mobile-clinic referral ledger.

cases.name: observatory scheduling board
cases.prompt: Create an observatory scheduling board. Astronomers propose targets, telescope operators approve windows, and weather officers cancel runs when the sky monitor fails. Use the cloud observatory scheduler and sky monitor feed, retain approval history, and do not automatically publish target coordinates.

cases.name: observatory research brief
cases.prompt:
RESEARCH NOTE: OBSERVATORY OPERATIONS
Astronomers propose targets before telescope operators approve windows. Weather officers cancel a run when the sky monitor fails. The cloud observatory scheduler and sky monitor feed are required systems. Keep approval history and never publish target coordinates automatically.
Request: turn the note into an observatory scheduling proposal.

cases.name: archive access conflict
cases.prompt:
ARCHIVE RESEARCH PACKET
Archivists catalog oral-history recordings; transcribers attach drafts; rights officers approve release. The first consent form permits educational access, while a later family letter limits access to family researchers. The transcript service may be used, but the controlling rights policy and precedence rule are missing. Preserve original audio and do not publish any transcript until those are supplied.
Deliverable: propose the archive workflow.

cases.name: ferry maintenance research
cases.prompt:
RESEARCH EVIDENCE: FERRY OPERATIONS
Deck crews log defects. Mechanics attach repair certificates. Harbor supervisors reopen vessels after supervisor signoff. Engine hours come from the ferry telemetry service. Retain original defect notes, do not authorize passenger service without supervisor signoff, and produce a weekly readiness report.
Request: create the ferry maintenance register.

cases.name: ferry maintenance handoff
cases.prompt:
PASTED FERRY HANDOFF
Sequence: deck crews log defects; mechanics attach repair certificates; harbor supervisors reopen vessels only after supervisor signoff. Engine hours come from the ferry telemetry service. Keep original defect notes. Do not authorize passenger service without supervisor signoff. Output a weekly readiness report.
Request: restate the register plan.

cases.name: ferry approved amendment
cases.prompt:
## Ferry register amendment
Keep the ferry maintenance register. Deck crews log defects, mechanics attach repair certificates, and harbor supervisors reopen vessels after supervisor signoff. The ferry telemetry service supplies engine hours. Added: a mechanic escalation queue. Retain original defect notes and produce a weekly readiness report. Do not authorize passenger service without supervisor signoff.

cases.name: coral nursery evidence
cases.prompt:
RESEARCH EVIDENCE
Field protocol: nursery technicians tag coral fragments, marine biologists approve outplant sites, and boat crews record deployment coordinates. The NOAA-style sensor archive supplies salinity history. Preserve chain-of-custody photos for ten years, do not predict survival rates, and flag missing coordinates for human review.
Proposal request: create the coral nursery evidence register.

cases.name: community radio rights packet
cases.prompt:
RESEARCH PACKET: COMMUNITY RADIO
Producers submit episode metadata, editors verify music licenses, and archivists retain master files. The transcript vendor is an external system. Keep license evidence for seven years, do not publish an episode with an unresolved rights flag, and route uncertain matches to a rights reviewer. Request: propose a community-radio archive.

cases.name: museum access contradiction
cases.prompt:
RESEARCH FILE: MUSEUM LOAN
Registrars inventory objects, conservators attach condition reports, and lenders approve display. A signed loan form allows public display, but a later insurer addendum says display is restricted to accredited researchers. The collections portal is available, yet the controlling restriction and document-precedence rule are unspecified. Preserve both source documents and do not publish a display schedule until the restriction is resolved.
Request: design the museum-loan register.

cases.name: observatory restatement
cases.prompt:
## Restated observatory plan
Weather officers cancel runs when the sky monitor fails; astronomers propose targets; telescope operators approve windows. The cloud observatory scheduler and sky monitor feed support the board. Retain approval history. Automatic publication of target coordinates is prohibited.

cases.name: river allocation queue
cases.prompt: Set up a river-basin water allocation request queue. Farmers submit seasonal requests, hydrologists review measurements, and basin administrators issue allocations. The meter exchange is an external dependency. The priority rule between household use and crop use is not provided, and the drought override authority is unspecified; do not issue an allocation until both are confirmed.

cases.name: festival vendor scheduler
cases.prompt: Create a neighborhood festival vendor scheduler. Vendors need booth assignments and payment status, but the allocation rule and cancellation authority are unspecified.

cases.name: climbing club contact records
cases.prompt: Track volunteer waivers and emergency contacts for a climbing club. Decide the retention period and who may access the contacts. Do not choose either policy without the club's direction.

cases.name: teaching lab sample handoff
cases.prompt: Build a lab-sample handoff tracker for a teaching lab. Teaching lab staff record sample IDs and custody transfers. The biosafety owner and spill-response procedure are not supplied; do not authorize hazardous handling until they are named.

cases.name: cooperative apartment repair queue
cases.prompt: Make a repair queue for a cooperative apartment building: tenants report leaks, caretakers assign work, and inspectors close tickets after a visit. Keep the inspection date, do not dispatch emergency crews, and use no external service.
